description:
KNKMiami is a family business based in sunny Florida. We are invested in providing dancers and athletes with quality products that help them perform better.
 
One of our top products is the Circular Yoga Block which is designed to be exceptionally stable and durable, providing the support you need for advanced poses and intensive practice. Our Circular Yoga Block isn't just any yoga block. It's crafted to have the highest density in the market, ensuring unparalleled stability and durability. This level of quality extends to our bands as well, making them the perfect companions for a comprehensive workout. Unlike competitors sacrificing quality for price, our products guarantee stability and durability, essential for advanced poses and rigorous workouts.
 
One of the standout features of our Circular Yoga Block is its innovative design, which includes grooves and spaces underneath specifically for threading different types of exercise bands. This feature is essential for creating a versatile and effective workout experience, accommodating our light, medium, and heavy resistance bands. This ensures optimal alignment and stability, unlike regular blocks.
 
In addition, our Circular Yoga Block is officially recognized under the United States Patent No.: US011607574B1, granted on Mar. 21, 2023. This patent underscores the unique design and quality of our product, setting it apart from anything else on the market.
 
On top of that, our product range includes other exciting and innovative products like the Spring Core Balance in four different levels. This device that targets turnout, turning, balance, promenading, ankle strength, hip rotation, back strength, core strength, spotting, proper muscle memory, and control. All in one! The SpringCore Balance is very challenging and intended for advanced athletes.
 
You can have a look on our Instagram profile and our website knkmiami.com to see for yourself what we are all about.
